# Verification — Step 3, Reference: rise_of_the_ottomans.txt:2801, Quote: "num_locations > 100"
# Verification — Step 3, Reference: country_triggers.txt:227, Quote: "has_variable = unlocked_advance_$type$"
# Score = num_locations + 0.5 * subject_or_below locations (computed monthly by tv_update_conquest_score_effect)

	has_variable = tv_conquest_score

}

# TRADE VICTORY MILESTONES
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Verification — Step 3, Reference: events/economy/trade.txt:185, Quote: "monthly_trade_income > { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = 0.33 }"
# Score = monthly_trade_income (computed monthly by tv_update_trade_score_effect; thresholds require in-game tuning)

tv_trade_milestone_1 = {
	has_variable = tv_trade_score
	var:tv_trade_score >= 100
}

tv_trade_milestone_2 = {
	has_variable = tv_trade_score
	var:tv_trade_score >= 200
}

tv_trade_milestone_3 = {
	has_variable = tv_trade_score
	var:tv_trade_score >= 400
	# Verification — Step 3, Reference: events/economy/trade.txt:129, Quote: "any_market_with_merchants = { most_powerful_merchant = root"
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = tv_trade_market_dominance_5_tt
		any_market_with_merchants = {
			most_powerful_merchant = root
			count >= 5
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_milestone_4 = {
	has_variable = tv_trade_score
	var:tv_trade_score >= 1000
}

tv_trade_milestone_5 = {
	has_variable = tv_trade_score
	var:tv_trade_score >= 2000
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = tv_trade_market_dominance_10_tt
		any_market_with_merchants = {
			most_powerful_merchant = root
			count >= 10
		}
	}
}
